final_method: Equal average of three ridge models using GigaPath, BiomedCLIP, and DINOv2/H-optimus tile quantiles.
interpretation: The observed gain is small and the uncertainty interval includes zero. Official held-out performance is unknown. Feature-family development reused the labelled data.

experiments.name: Existing tile-level distribution features
experiments.outcome: Retained DINOv2 and H-optimus quantiles in the stable ensemble.

experiments.name: 20x DINOv2
experiments.outcome: Did not improve validation; excluded from final model. Features retained for future experiments.

experiments.name: DINOv2 whole-slide thumbnail and quadrant views
experiments.outcome: Did not improve exploratory validation; excluded.

experiments.name: Support-vector classifiers
experiments.outcome: All tested candidates scored below the retained ridge models in exploratory leave-one-out validation.

experiments.name: Multinomial logistic classifiers
experiments.outcome: All tested candidates scored below the retained ridge models in exploratory leave-one-out validation.

experiments.name: Broad kernel search
experiments.outcome: Reduced to three stable feature families; broad selection was less consistent.

limitations: Larger pathology-specific checkpoints could not be downloaded because this execution environment lacks network access.
The cached DINOv2 model ran locally on CPU.
No official answer key, filenames as features, supplier identifiers as features, or report text was used.
checks: All 67 output IDs and organ groups validated.
No exact duplicate thumbnail hashes or GigaPath vector pairs with cosine above 0.999 were found; this does not establish patient independence.
